+import itertools
+import pandas as pd
+from sklearn.metrics import cohen_kappa_score
+from statsmodels.stats.inter_rater import fleiss_kappa, aggregate_raters
+
+R = {r: pd.read_csv(f"data/cs1_fall25/labels_{r}.csv").set_index("window_id").label for r in ("r1", "r2", "r3")}
+df = pd.DataFrame(R).dropna()
+states = sorted(set(df.values.ravel()))
+codes = df.apply(lambda c: c.map({s: i for i, s in enumerate(states)}))
+print(f"windows: {len(df)}")
+print(f"Fleiss kappa (3 raters): {fleiss_kappa(aggregate_raters(codes.values)[0]):.2f}")
+for a, b in itertools.combinations(R, 2):
+    print(f"Cohen {a}-{b}: {cohen_kappa_score(df[a], df[b]):.2f}")
+print("\nstate & kappa \\\\")
+for s in states:
+    bin_ = (df == s).astype(int)
+    print(f"{s} & {fleiss_kappa(aggregate_raters(bin_.values)[0]):.2f} \\\\")
*** End Patch
